state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The gap `the-guided-install-is-reached-by-no-command` is closed, and `rule:ide/the-extension-guides-an-install-and-never-bundles-one` is `shipped`. `nvs.downloadBinary` and `nvs.openReleases` are contributed and registered. `editors/vscode/src/binary.ts` tries three candidates in order (`nvs.path`, `PATH`, the installed copy), and `extension.ts` falls back to the installed copy when the first candidate does not start or is refused at `initialize`. The status item names the candidate that answered, and offers the download when none does. `docs/reference/tools/40-editor.md` has the install section, and its command table no longer says `nvs.run`, `nvs.test` and `nvs.showAst` are unanswered.

A `decimal` *property* default is still refused (`E0472`), because `nvs_runtime::FieldDefault` has no `decimal` recipe. The module doc of `crates/nvs-types/src/defaults.rs` says so.

`startsWith` and `endsWith` still compare bytes. Whether they join the search family is still open.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest: 23 gaps in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-types`, `nvs-runtime`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.

items.text: **A markup region gets Emmet and validation, or the rule names only what it gets** (gap `a-template-region-gets-no-emmet-and-no-validation`, `rule:ide/a-template-region-gets-the-editors-services-and-formatter`). The module doc at `editors/vscode/src/regions.ts:22` says why neither is built. Either build both with a mechanism that reaches only the markup, with a host test, or narrow the rule's fragment to the services the forwarding reaches; the narrowing is the cheap close and the gap's text allows it.

**The guided install gets a host case** — `editors/vscode/test/host/surfaces.test.ts:1` reads the status item through `Surface`; a case with `nvs.path` at a missing file and nothing on `PATH` asserts the item's command is `nvs.downloadBinary` (`rule:ide/the-extension-guides-an-install-and-never-bundles-one`, `editors/vscode/src/extension.ts:330`). Only if the host suite can run with an empty `PATH`.

backlog: `website` gaps: the hand-written grammar and the stale rendered `Core` pages (`website/scripts`).
